newsitem.title: USA: Bell Atlantic, GlobalKey in security pact.
newsitem.headline: Bell Atlantic, GlobalKey in security pact.

text.p: GlobalKey Inc Wednesday said it signed a one-year contract with Bell Atlantic Corp, under which Bell Atlantic will integrate GlobalKey's high-level encryption technology to enhance the company's existing communications systems.

Initially, the company will offer GlobalKey's security through the company's Federal Systems division, which develops communications programs specifically for federal government applications. Plans for future implementations include security products for Bell Atlantic's commercial accounts.

"Transmitting sensitive information is a concern for both the intelligence community and the commercial marketplace. We see GlobalKey as part of a horizontal solution that will fit many vertical applications," said George Holland of Bell Atlantic Federal Systems.

GlobalKey's service allows users to send secure messages from their computer network, terminal or laptop anywhere in the world in seconds with instant return receipt and no gateway delays, the company said.
